import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtSeparated
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

-- V1: with THIS FILE's instances in scope, is IsSeparated free for an arbitrary k-scheme?
example {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) : IsSeparated X.hom := by
  infer_instance

-- V2: same, allowing all of mathlib+project term search
example {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) : IsSeparated X.hom := by
  exact?

-- V3: does LocallyOfFiniteType follow from rep?  (claim 2: must FAIL)
example {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (rep : (Scheme.PicScheme.picEt C).RepresentableBy X) :
    LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom := by
  exact?
